item.title: WAGO: Multiple Devices affected by PHP2Shell
item.description: [VDE-2026-132] Critical vulnerabilities in the PHP runtime may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code by exploiting weaknesses in PHP's internal memory and request handling mechanisms. Under specific conditions, specially crafted web requests can trigger unexpected behavior that could compromise the affected web server process. WAGO controllers with the integrated web server enabled and running an affected PHP version are exposed to these vulnerabilities.

item.title: Phoenix Contact: Reliability Layer unbounded TLS Timeout and ACKs for non-outstanding Packets in OpenVPN in FL MGUARD 2xxx and 4xxx firmware
item.description: [VDE-2026-122] The OpenVPN package used in the affected mGuard products is vulnerable to a denial of service attack against the control channel reliability layer.

item.title: Phoenix Contact: PHP2Shell in FL SWITCH, FL NAT and FL WLAN devices
item.description: [VDE-2026-144] Two vulnerabilities have been identified in the PHP component used in FL SWITCH, FL NAT, and FL WLAN devices. The vulnerabilities relate to improper memory handling in PHP and can lead to remote code execution (RCE).
